title: Qualify mandatory zero-paid-requirement execution
objective: Bind the WU01 static inventory to live public-repository evidence and current official GitHub Actions billing semantics, prove that mandatory standard-runner execution requires no paid spend, and adversarially reject private visibility, paid runners, paid provider secrets, unapproved actions, or any cost-policy flip without changing mandatory workflows.
non_goals: claim the entire GitHub account can never incur optional billing
query billing balances or payment methods
increase Actions cache or artifact storage limits

required_invariants: WU01 static verdict must be PASS_WITH_VISIBILITY_UNVERIFIED before qualification
live evidence binds repository id full name default branch visibility and archived state from GitHub connector observation
all mandatory runner labels must be standard public GitHub-hosted runner labels covered by the cited GitHub billing rule
larger runners remain rejected because GitHub bills them even for public repositories
mandatory workflows may not require Actions artifact storage or a paid cache expansion
the existing setup-python pip cache is acceptable only because no cache expansion beyond the included repository allowance is required
qualification verdict is scoped to mandatory execution requirements and never claims account-wide optional spend is impossible
private repository visibility paid-provider secrets paid runners unapproved actions or any true cost-policy value fail closed
acceptance_criteria: exact live repository evidence identifies tobianahillel-afk/Bot-crypto as public id 1322269966
official GitHub Actions billing evidence states standard GitHub-hosted runners are free for public repositories
official evidence states larger runners are always charged
qualified result explicitly excludes optional account-wide billing and paid cache-limit expansion from its claim
at least ten adversarial cost scenarios fail closed
qualification executes through the existing WU01 bootstrap step only while WU02 is active

done_when: live public-repository evidence is bound to the exact zero-cost qualification
current official GitHub billing semantics are recorded with source and observation date
mandatory runner minutes require no paid spend under the public standard-runner rule
mandatory path requires no paid API LLM SaaS license larger runner or paid cache expansion
adversarial qualification fails closed on every paid/private variant
